ai_summary: Avonmore Capital & Management Services Ltd. has approved the amalgamation of four wholly-owned subsidiaries, including two reporting negative turnovers, into the parent company. This strategic move aims to simplify the corporate structure, rationalize operations, and reduce costs, without impacting the listed entity's shareholding pattern. The consolidation is presented as an effort to enhance efficiency within the NBFC's group investments, absorbing these entities into the core business.
